text:
olivia: Hey team :wave: — heads up: we're deprecating the legacy /v1/models endpoint and migrating docs/examples to the new /v2/model-serve API. I opened an initial PR with suggested wording and code swaps: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1379

matt_devdocs: saw the PR, thanks. do we have a clear mapping of param names? v1 uses model_id and prompt, v2 expects model and input. Also model swapping behavior changed — need to call that out.

jun: correct. also v2 returns streaming tokens differently (chunked payloads), so examples must show both streaming and non-streaming.

pm_raj: timeline? we need the deprecation notice on the status page and a banner for the console at least 30 days before enforcement.

olivia: target deprecation date: 2026-06-01. I'll add the status page draft. For docs PR I want the migration guide to include three short patterns: curl, python (v2 SDK), and node. Keep them tiny snippets, not full notebooks.

docs-bot: Reminder: Per docs policy, include an automatic redirect from /v1/models to the migration page and add a changelog entry.

matt_devdocs: draft snippets below — take or modify: ```bash
# v1 curl
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}'

# v2 curl
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v2/model-serve -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"Hello"}'
```

jun: SDK example differences — v1 python client used `client.generate(model_id='x', prompt='y')`. v2 python should be `client.model_serve.create(model='x', input='y')`. Also the response object shape changed (`.text` -> `.outputs[0].content`).

olivia: good catch. please add a short code diff snippet in the migration guide showing the exact rename. reviewers will appreciate that.

matt_devdocs: added diff in the PR description. also updated node example to show streaming via EventSource.

pm_raj: do we need to add compatibility notes for Dedicated and Private customers? Might need different rollout notes and a flag for no-redirect if they self-host.

olivia: yes. add a short section: "For Dedicated/Private deployments" — mention that admins must update their infra to route /v2 and that we will not auto-redirect for on-prem. I'll paste a template email for partner comms into the PR.

sam_infra: pinging infra — we'll create a redirect rule for hosted accounts and a feature flag to gate the console banner. ETA: 3 biz days after PR merges.

matt_devdocs: small nit: update the examples page nav and add a note at top: 'If you are using the v1 SDK, see migration guide.' Avoid duplicate content.

jun: tests — add a little e2e that calls the example curl in CI (mocked) so snippets stay valid. I can add that to the docs CI job.

olivia: checklist for the PR before merging:
- [ ] migration guide with curl/python/node diffs
- [ ] changelog entry and status-page draft
- [ ] redirect rule + infra ticket linked
- [ ] Dedicated/Private section + partner email template
- [ ] unit/snippet smoke tests in docs CI

matt_devdocs: I'm on the first three items, will push another commit today.

pm_raj: communications plan looks good. Please loop legal if we need special wording for contracts.

olivia: thanks everyone. @matt_devdocs, @jun please leave comments in the PR for any wording you'd like changed. I'll aim to merge 2026-05-02 so infra has time to deploy before 2026-06-01 enforcement. :thumbsup:
